Name: Unrepair
Description:
Your cold hands imprint a deadly curse upon whoever they touch while this spell is active. Make a melee spell attack against one creature within reach.

On a hit, the target takes 4d6 necrotic damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they can’t recover hit points while you’re concentrating on the spell, and on each of your subsequent turns, you can take a bonus action to deal 2d6 necrotic damage to the target automatically.

On a successful save, the target still can’t recover hit points for the duration of the spell, but you won’t be able to use a bonus action to damage them.
